xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2467: Multi-repo merge train merges only one repo, strands sibling repos' branches (MIN-857 api half never merged)

plan.title: Multi-repo merge train merges only one repo, strands sibling repos' branches (MIN-857 api half never merged)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The issue-level 'merged' decision is single-PR everywhere. The coordinated polyrepo merge (merge-ops.ts:518) silently filters out required repos that have commits but no MR (artifactUrl absent), merges the remaining repos, and flips the issue to merged — the exact MIN-857 mechanism where the api repo's feature/min-857 branch (2 UAT-critical commits, no MR) was stranded while the frontend merge marked the issue done. verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle checks one PR in one repo, and the forge-merge route counts artifact-less repos as merged. MergeSetRepoState.required is written but read by zero decisions; nothing aggregates 'all required repos merged'.
narratives.Proposal: Add assessMergeCompleteness in a new src/lib/cloister/merge-completeness.ts: enumerate repos through the MergeSet/project-repos door, classify each required repo as merged | no-changes | unmerged | unverifiable using a squash-safe evidence rule (git commits-ahead on origin/source vs origin/target in the primary checkout, plus a new forge findMergedArtifact lookup on both GitHub and GitLab adapters), fail closed on unverifiable. Wire it as a pre-flight gate in the coordinated polyrepo merge (with discoverArtifact self-heal before blocking), into verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle for multi-repo merge sets so every postMergeLifecycle entry path is guarded, and into the forge-merge route. Surface blocks as a new 'unmerged_sibling_repo' blocker type in MERGE_BLOCKER_TYPES. Guard test proves a polyrepo issue with one stranded required repo never reaches mergeStatus 'merged'.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not touch pan sync-main (PAN-3037), pan strike / merge-strike.ts (PAN-3040), or the UAT batch train (PAN-1696) — campaign siblings own those surfaces
- Do not change auto-merge-eligibility.ts / flywheel auto-merge gating
- Do not change verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle's pre-existing non-GitHub early return for single-repo projects
- Do not build a new repo resolver or add workspaceConfig.type === 'polyrepo' conditionals at call sites — the project-repos door is the only enumeration path
- Do not fix review-artifacts.ts MR-creation retry behavior (upstream of the gate; gate must handle its output instead)
- Do not touch the PAN-328 postMergeLifecycle idempotency guard machinery
- Do not add per-repo UI to the dashboard beyond the existing merge-blockers surface

autoDecisions.summary: Evidence rule: git commits-ahead PLUS forge merged-artifact lookup, not git alone.
autoDecisions.rationale: Squash merges leave branch commits permanently unreachable from target; git-only evidence would false-report unmerged forever. Forge-only evidence cannot detect the no-MR stranding case.

autoDecisions.summary: Unverifiable repo state fails closed (blocks the train with a reason).
autoDecisions.rationale: Silent partial delivery is the incident class this issue exists to eliminate; a retryable block with an actionable reason is strictly better than shipping half a feature.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate placement: merge-ops coordinated-merge pre-flight + verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle chokepoint only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every postMergeLifecycle caller funnels through the chokepoint; merge-ops is the GitLab-polyrepo path MIN-857 actually took. Strike/UAT/auto-merge surfaces belong to campaign siblings PAN-3040/PAN-1696.

autoDecisions.summary: Self-heal missing artifactUrl via discoverArtifact before blocking.
autoDecisions.rationale: An artifact that exists but was never recorded (creation race) is recoverable without operator action; blocking on it would be a false positive.

autoDecisions.summary: New 'unmerged_sibling_repo' blocker type instead of overloading 'not_mergeable'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The flywheel and operator need to see which repo is stranded without reading logs; a named type keeps the merge-blockers payload actionable.

autoDecisions.summary: GitLab merged-MR lookup uses `glab mr list --source-branch <b> --all --output json` with client-side state === 'merged' filtering if the merged filter flag cannot be confirmed via --help.
autoDecisions.rationale: The default glab mr list shows open MRs only; client-side filtering on the returned state field is flag-agnostic and robust across glab versions.

items.title: Add findMergedArtifact to both forge adapters

narrative.Action: Add `findMergedArtifact(input: DiscoverArtifactInput): Promise<CreateReviewArtifactResult | null>` to the ForgeAdapter interface (src/lib/forge.ts:95) and implement it on both adapters. GitHub: mirror getExistingGitHubArtifact (forge.ts:133) — app path uses listPullRequestsForHead(owner, repo, branch, 'all') filtered by pr.merged || pr.mergedAt || pr.mergeCommit (same predicate as merged-pr-verification.ts:32); CLI fallback uses `gh pr list --state merged --head <branch> --json url,number,mergedAt`. GitLab: mirror getExistingGitLabArtifact (forge.ts:167); checkpoint — verify a merged filter flag with `glab mr list --help`, decided fallback is `glab mr list --source-branch <b> --all --output json` with client-side filter on state === 'merged'. Return { forge, created: false, url, id }. Async exec only (server-reachable; no execSync). Unit tests mock exec/API for both adapters.

items.title: Given a branch with a merged PR/MR, findMergedArtifact returns the artifact's url and id on both the GitHub and GitLab adapters (mocked exec/API)
Given a branch with only an open (unmerged) artifact or no artifact, findMergedArtifact returns null on both adapters
The GitLab implementation accepts MRs whose returned state field equals 'merged' and rejects state 'opened'/'closed', so squash-merged GitLab branches resolve as merged
Create merge-completeness assessor module

expected_outputs: merge-completeness.test.ts passes all five classification scenarios
metadata.readinessReason: Creates only a new module and a new test file; no shared-file contention with any sibling item once forge-merged-artifact has landed

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/merge-completeness.ts exporting assessMergeCompleteness(issueId, labels?) -> { complete, repos: [{ repoKey, state: 'merged'|'no-changes'|'unmerged'|'unverifiable', aheadCount, artifactUrl?, reason }], summary }. Enumerate repos via ensureMergeSetForIssueSync (door; falls back to resolveProjectReposForIssueSync only if the set cannot be built). Per required repo, in the PRIMARY checkout (ResolvedProjectRepo.repoPath — workspaces may be torn down): `git fetch origin <sourceBranch> <targetBranch>` tolerating a missing source branch, then `git rev-list --count origin/<targetBranch>..origin/<sourceBranch>`. aheadCount 0 or branch absent -> 'no-changes'. aheadCount > 0 -> getForgeAdapter(repo.forge).findMergedArtifact; found -> 'merged'; absent -> 'unmerged' with reason naming repoKey, aheadCount, branches. Any exec/forge error -> 'unverifiable' (fail closed). required === false repos recorded as 'no-changes' (readonly). complete = every repo 'merged' or 'no-changes'. All subprocess calls async (no execSync). Tests inject mocked exec + adapters: all-merged, one stranded, squash-merged-with-merged-MR, fetch-failure -> unverifiable -> complete false, monorepo single-entry set. Inspection: the result shape and classification semantics are consumed by four downstream items.

items.title: Given a polyrepo set with one required repo 2 commits ahead and no merged artifact, assessMergeCompleteness returns complete false and that repo's entry has state 'unmerged' with a reason naming the repoKey and count
Given a repo whose branch is commits-ahead but has a merged artifact (squash merge), the assessor returns state 'merged' for it and complete true when siblings are clean
Given a git fetch or forge error for any repo, the assessor returns state 'unverifiable' for that repo and complete false (fails closed)
Given a monorepo project (single synthetic repo entry) or an absent source branch, the assessor returns complete true with states 'merged' or 'no-changes' and never throws

The module enumerates repos only through ensureMergeSetForIssueSync/resolveProjectReposForIssueSync and contains no execSync call and no workspaceConfig.type conditional (verifiable by reading the diff)
Wire completeness into verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle

expected_outputs: merge-verification.test.ts passes including new polyrepo cases

narrative.Action: In verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle (src/lib/cloister/merged-pr-verification.ts:13), after the existing single-PR verification finds a merged PR (both the app-API return at :33-35 and the gh-CLI return at :52-54), and only when getMergeSetSync(issueId)?.repos.length > 1: call assessMergeCompleteness(issueId). If incomplete, return { merged: false, reason: 'sibling repo(s) unmerged: ' + summary } instead of merged true. Monorepo behavior stays byte-identical (assessor not invoked). The non-GitHub early return at :24-26 is untouched. Do not modify postMergeLifecycle's PAN-328 idempotency machinery. Extend tests/unit/lib/cloister/merge-verification.test.ts: stranded-sibling polyrepo -> merged false naming the repo; all-merged polyrepo -> merged true; monorepo -> assessor spy not called.

items.title: Given a multi-repo merge set with a stranded sibling, verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle returns merged false with a reason naming the unmerged repo even though the tracker repo's PR is merged
Given a multi-repo merge set whose repos are all merged or change-free, verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle returns merged true exactly as before
Given a monorepo issue, the assessor is never invoked (spy) and existing merge-verification and in-flight-guard tests pass unchanged
Block coordinated polyrepo merge on stranded required repos

expected_outputs: lint including lint:file-size passes (merge-ops.ts at or below baseline, or audited baseline bump in same commit)

narrative.Action: In the coordinated polyrepo merge path (src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/merge-ops.ts, between building mergeSet at :510 and the merge loop): compute stranded = mergeSet.repos.filter(r => r.required && r.mergeStatus !== 'skipped' && !r.artifactUrl). For each stranded repo: (1) self-heal via getForgeAdapter(repo.forge).discoverArtifact — if found, record via withRepoArtifactUrlSync + upsertMergeSetSync so the repo joins activeRepos; (2) otherwise classify with the assessor's per-repo logic (export a reconcileStrandedRepos(mergeSet) helper from merge-completeness.ts so merge-ops gains only a short call-and-branch block — the file is baselined at 1923 lines and may not grow; if it still nets above baseline, bump scripts/file-size-baseline.txt in the SAME commit with a PAN-2467 audit reference): 'no-changes' -> withRepoStateSync mergeStatus 'skipped'; 'unmerged'/'unverifiable' -> set MergeSet status 'failed', setReviewStatus(issueId, { mergeStatus: 'failed', readyForMerge: false, mergeNotes: <repo-naming reason>, blockerReasons: [{ type: 'unmerged_sibling_repo', summary: <reason> }] }) following the shape at merge-ops.ts:844-856, completePendingOperation(issueId, error), return { success: false, statusCode: 409 }. The merged flip at :757-768 must be reachable only when every required repo is merged or genuinely change-free.

items.title: Given a required repo with commits ahead and no discoverable artifact, the coordinated merge returns success false with statusCode 409, sets review_status mergeStatus 'failed', and never fires postMergeLifecycle
Given a stranded repo whose artifact exists on the forge but was unrecorded, discoverArtifact self-heals the artifactUrl and the repo is merged as part of activeRepos
Given a required repo with zero commits ahead and no artifact, the gate records mergeStatus 'skipped' and the coordinated merge proceeds to merged
A blocked merge records a blockerReasons entry of type 'unmerged_sibling_repo' whose summary contains the stranded repo's repoKey
npm run lint passes with merge-ops.ts at or below its file-size baseline, or the same commit carries the audited baseline edit referencing PAN-2467
forge-merge route: stop counting artifact-less repos as merged

expected_outputs: lint including lint:file-size passes under the same baseline discipline as the coordinated-merge item

narrative.Action: In POST /api/issues/:id/forge-merge (merge-ops.ts:1373-1456): where artifact discovery finds nothing (:1409-1416, currently mergeStatus 'skipped' + merged: true), classify the repo with the assessor's per-repo logic. 'no-changes' -> keep skipped + merged true (correct for change-free repos). Commits ahead -> push { repo, merged: false, message: <reason naming repo and count> } and set mergeStatus 'blocked'. allMerged at :1456 then correctly reports false and the route does not fire postMergeLifecycle. Same file-size-baseline discipline as the coordinated-merge item.

items.title: Given a repo with commits ahead and no discoverable artifact, forge-merge's per-repo result reports merged false with a reason and the repo's mergeStatus becomes 'blocked'
Given all repos merged or change-free, forge-merge reports allMerged true and fires postMergeLifecycle exactly as before
Given any repo blocked, the route returns allMerged false and never invokes postMergeLifecycle (spy or call-log evidence)

Guard test: stranded sibling never reaches merged

expected_outputs: both guard scenarios pass: blocked-when-stranded and proceeds-when-change-free

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/__tests__/merge-ops-polyrepo-completeness.test.ts following the DI/mocking pattern of merge-ops-dirty-gate.test.ts. Scenario 1 (the issue's mandated guard): polyrepo MergeSet where repo A has mergeStatus 'pending' with artifactUrl and repo B is required with no artifactUrl, mocked classification 'unmerged' (2 commits ahead, discoverArtifact returns null). Assert the coordinated merge returns success false; review_status mergeStatus is 'failed' and never 'merged'; MergeSet status is 'failed'; error and blocker reason name repo B; postMergeLifecycle spy not called. Scenario 2: repo B change-free -> merge proceeds and the set flips to merged. No real timers or real subprocesses — mock exec; use vi.useFakeTimers if any delay path is exercised (repo rule).

items.title: Given repo B required, artifact-less, and 2 commits ahead, the coordinated merge test asserts the issue's mergeStatus is 'failed' and postMergeLifecycle is never invoked
In scenario 1 the failure error and the blockerReasons summary each contains repo B's repoKey
Given repo B change-free, the merge proceeds and the MergeSet status becomes 'merged' (no false blocking)
